newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money unchanged at 3.05/10 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money unchanged at 3.05/10 percent.

text.p: German call money rates were quoted at 3.05 to 3.10 percent on Monday, unchanged from Friday, as the market continued to recover from end-month liquidity strains.
Dealers said banks had by the end of last week repaid all the Lombard funds they had borrowed to meet end-month reserve requirements.

Commercial banks' effective reserves at the Bundesbank fell to 41.2 billion marks on Thursday from 42.5 billion on Wednesday. Average daily reserves for the month through Sunday totalled 41.2 billion marks, up from 39.0 billion.
Lombard borrowings were negligible on Friday. The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was 3.09100 percent on Monday, compared with 3.09846 percent.
